title: No committed contract carries a status the schema forbids
description: Four contracts carry "pending", which ContractStatusSchema does not permit — they load only because loadContract parses non-strictly. Migrate them and add the guard that would have caught it when it happened.

successCriteria.description: The four contracts from spec-20260604-docs-correction carrying "pending" are migrated to a legal member of ContractStatusSchema, with the chosen value justified in the commit message.
A test reads every committed contract in .bober/contracts/ and asserts its status parses against ContractStatusSchema, failing on any value outside the enum.
The test is proven to bite by mutation: an illegal status introduced in a temp copy fails it.
The test reads the directory at run time rather than a hardcoded file list, so a newly added contract is covered automatically.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build are green.

nonGoals: Adding "pending" to the enum — the decision was to fix the data, not widen the schema.
Rewriting any other field of those four contracts.
stopConditions: Migrating a status would change what a completed spec's history claims — if so, report which and pick the value that preserves the record.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, the golden gate passing, and every documentation claim added backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: The four are sprint-spec-20260604-docs-correction-{1,2,3,4}.json. They belong to a long-finished spec, so the stakes are low — pick the legal value that best preserves what actually happened and say why. Note the guard test overlaps in spirit with the golden dataset-integrity checks; look at how those read a directory at run time and follow that shape rather than inventing one.
evaluatorNotes: Verify all four migrated files parse strictly. Verify sc-2-2 reads the directory rather than a list by adding a temp contract with a bad status and confirming it is caught. Check nothing else in those four files changed.
